items.title: Normal session
items.description: CONNECT → AUTHORIZE_SESSION → START_CHARGING → SET_POWER 5 kW → all ALLOW

items.name: excess_power
items.title: Excess power attack
items.description: Reach CHARGING, then request 20 kW on a 7 kW session → BLOCK

items.name: invalid_state
items.title: Invalid state attack
items.description: Fresh session sends START_CHARGING before authorization → BLOCK

items.name: excess_current
items.title: Excess current attack
items.description: SET_CURRENT 16 A ALLOW, then SET_CURRENT 40 A → BLOCK

items.name: invalid_token
items.title: Invalid token
items.description: CONNECT using an unknown token → BLOCK

items.name: rate_burst
items.title: Rate burst
items.description: Rapid commands exceed the configured command rate → BLOCK

items.name: full_lifecycle
items.title: Full lifecycle
items.description: Complete charging lifecycle followed by an invalid duplicate disconnect
